overview: Life in a modern South Korean office can be eventful! Lee Jun once hoped to become a top-billing pop star, but has turned his back on his dreams. Now this former idol star needs to enter the world of work. But without any experience, he is forced to take on a role as an intern at a cosmetics firm. Here he is reunited with someone from his past – a highly talented (but also highly flirtatious!) man named Choi Jun. Choi Jun has risen to the post of manager at the company, which means he is able to delegate work to the company's long-suffering interns! The interns' only ally is Lee Joo Ha, an assistant manager who tries to shield them from managers' ire! While the workload starts piling up for Lee Jun, so does the romantic tension between this former pop star and Choi Jun. And theirs is not the only possible office romance in the cards – as employees Simeon and Song Hyun Jae also start to feel the pull of love!
title: Jun and Jun

overview: Oğuz has losaves a young amnesiac woman, Defne, who he brings into his home. But when Defne recovers her memory, she realizes that she was a con artist who must remain in hiding.
title: Maviye Sürgün

overview: The "good life" is just one scam away. This thought takes root in the minds of two friends Bhargav and Siddhant after they read countless news stories of bank scams that have happened in the country and that a total of seventy-one thousand five hundred crores has been scammed. Together they devise a plan to open India's first fake bank. Will they get away or will they get caught?
title: Akkad Bakkad Rafu Chakkar

overview: Told over two parallel timelines, A Cruel Love: The Ruth Ellis Story reveals secret truths about the case which have remained hidden for decades, poses tantalising questions about what really happened in the months before Ruth killed her lover David Blakely, and sheds light on the life of one of Britain's most infamous murderesses. The drama depicts Ruth's entry into a dizzying upper class London world that promises so much, but ultimately delivers treachery. We follow her glamorous lifestyle as a young nightclub manageress, her abusive relationship with the man she later gunned down in cold blood, her arrest, trial and the subsequent legal fight to reprieve her before she was hanged by infamous hangman, Albert Pierrepoint, in Holloway Prison, aged just 28.
title: A Cruel Love: The Ruth Ellis Story

overview: A group of strangers share two weeks of self-discovery and romance, their hearts entangling as they bid farewell to youth and hello to adulthood.
title: Nineteen to Twenty

overview: John Fleming, Professor Madeleine Dawnay, and the artificially constructed Andromeda are kidnapped to Azaran in this sequel to A for Andromeda. While there, they discover a second machine and the reason for the original message. When the country's leader tries to use them and Andromeda, things begin to turn even worse.
title: The Andromeda Breakthrough

overview: Track the main events of World War II with the help of remarkable archive footage and see exactly what happened, and when. Learn about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb and more. From the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame, this extensive 24 episode series shines a spotlight on a period of history that should never be forgotten.
title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline

overview: Qin Chen, the supreme god of the Martial Domain, was a legendary figure in the Tianwu Continent. He met his demise after being betrayed by his beloved woman and trusted friend. Several hundreds of years later, his consciousness unexpectedly awakened within a young boy of the same name in the Da Xuan Kingdom. Utilizing his divine skills, young man Qin Chen cultivated profound techniques, refined divine pills, defied the heavens, and rose to power with great strength. Along the way, he formed bonds with like-minded companions and embarked on a journey that would shock the entire continent.
title: Dominator of Martial Gods

overview: Search Party with Brandon Jordan follows Brandon Jordan across the country searching for items lost underwater in hopes to return them to their owners. Brandon and his crew polling their social media followers to crowdsource leads for locating lost items believed to be hiding below the surface. Brandon dives into oceans, lakes, rivers, and canals where he is challenged by weather, wildlife, and water conditions in his expedition to find items that were once someone's prized possession.
title: Search Party with Brandon Jordan

overview: Journalist Norah dares to make a new start in Vienna. As soon as she arrives, a beggar prophesies that she will kill a man. She doesn't believe the incident - until strange things happen.
title: Der Schatten

overview: This is a compilation of 20 mini-stories of light romance situations between younger men and older women. The male cast is members of "Naniwa Boys", "Aぇ! group". and "Lil Kansai" that is a unit of "Kansai Johnny Jr."
title: Toshishita Kareshi

overview: A medical drama about two neurosurgeons. One, Dr. Doug Hanson, believes only in the facts and figures behind the science of the brain and the other, Dr. Jonathan Seger, believes that the psychology of the patient is more important.
title: 3 lbs.

overview: Comedian Chris McCausland visits the world's most stunning places. But he's blind, so he's joined by celebrity guests for commentary.
title: The Wonders of the World I Can't See

overview: Gece, who is planning to go to university, also dreams of making music with her boyfriend Emir all summer long. But all her dreams have to be put on hold for a while. Because for her sister Gülce, who is a special child, the crowd and noise of Istanbul has become more and more difficult to cope with. Gece, who does not want to leave her boyfriend and all her dreams in Istanbul, suddenly finds herself in Foça with her family. Gece, whose life is turned upside down, meets Özgür, who is an instructor at the sailing club where his brother was enrolled. Özgür is a handsome young man who devoted his life to his brother Rüzgar, who has Asperger's syndrome, after losing his parents in a fire. As Gece meets Özgür, she will learn to look at life from a more mature perspective, and Özgür will learn from Gece not to put life on hold. However, in this process, with the arrival of Gece's boyfriend Emir in Foça, difficult walls are formed between the two. Will Gece dare to go after true love?
title: Dönence

overview: Mysteries and many challenges are just some of the ingredients where a group of competitors tests their limits.
title: Os Traidores

overview: A young priest arrives in the city of Braga and takes care of a parish in a neighborhood of poor and excluded people. It is there that he meets Carlitos, a child who reveals to him, in confession, a terrible secret.
title: Braga

overview: Invicta Fighting Championships is a professional (MMA) promotion for female fighters based in the United States.
title: Invicta Fighting Championships

overview: Joko Winterscheidt takes on one of humanity's biggest challenges: the climate crisis. Joko reaches his limits on this journey, driven to despair by the state of the world. But he also meets people who are fighting for a better, more sustainable world and who give Joko hope.
title: Joko Winterscheidt Presents - The World's Most Dangerous Show

overview: Kinoshita Kazuya is a university student. Indecisive and soft, so as not to feel awkward, often deceives others, bypassing sharp corners in communication. Kazuya is not popular with the opposite sex, but he had a girlfriend, Mami Nanami. It was the first experience in a romantic relationship, which lasted only a month, after which Nanami left him. Kazuya is emotionally traumatized by the breakup, and in order to heal his broken heart, he orders a girl from an escort service. The choice fell on Mizuhara Chizuru. She is beautiful, witty, attentive, and does her job well as a hired girl, but Kazuyu sometimes gets nervous in her presence for some reason. One day, succumbing to an emotional impulse, Kazuya declares her his girlfriend. Based on the 2017 manga of the same name, by Miyajima Reiji.
title: Kanojo, Okarishimasu

overview: The story begins in a quiet small town where serial murders suddenly begin to occur. The victims are drained of blood, there are no leads, and the case has remained unsolved for five years. Yamihara Kokoro is a top—notch reporter for a weekly magazine, living with a secret she can't tell anyone about. Asada Toramatsu is a local policeman who also has his own secret. They have been in a relationship for a year and are starting to think about marriage, but the secrets they keep prevent them from moving forward in the relationship. And at the moment when Kokoro decides to reveal his secret to Toramatsu, a terrible murder takes place in the city again, involving the couple in a series of strange events.
title: Unknown

overview: An Xin'er comes from a rich family, but suffers from ichthyosis and is tortured by this disease. She was deceived by her scumbag boyfriend, who put her in danger, and she accidentally falls into the sea. Fortunately, she is rescued by Yu Sheng, an alien from the planet Kepler, and a legendary merman. As the king of the sea, Yu Sheng is simple, kind and naive.
title: Fish Show You

overview: Story tells the production and life stories of three generations of Chinese steel workers.
title: Red House

overview: Denis learns that the love of his life, Nastya, is an escort. In response to this, Denis, together with his friend Nikita, opens an escort agency and decides to return Nastya and "buy" her love. A business that began as a gamble has turned life into endless problems.
title: Немодельное агентство

overview: Perfectly capturing the wit of P.G Wodehouse's novels, this impeccable series traces the insane shenanigans of Bertram Wooster and his faithful butler Jeeves. Set against a 1930s backdrop of Hooray Henries and splendidly indomitable aunts, Jeeves battles against Wooster's relentless list of prospective brides to hilarious consequences.
title: Jeeves & Wooster

overview: A small group of friends, the strain of the Cold War, and secret agents from the KGB and FBI all come together in a mysterious, small Colorado town. Now on Netflix, BYUtv's first ever scripted drama, Granite Flats, will keep you on the edge of your seat as fear is felt, secrets are revealed, and friendships are tested.
title: Granite Flats

overview: The crimes that are distinct to one U.S. region, whether it is bodies that turn up in swamps in the Bayou, killers stalking the sandy beaches of the Jersey Shore, victims lusting for fame in the Hollywood Hills, or screams lost in the cold Alaskan tundra. The series illuminates what connects these crimes to their environments and what makes them so uniquely American.
title: Murder Nation
La Casa de los Famosos Mexico

overview: Teacher is a former doctor with a mysterious artificial hand. On the other hand, Dr. Chocolate is a 10-year-old with prodigious surgical skills and can perform any kind of operations. Joined by six other medical friends, they are known as the "Chocolate Company" and perform top-secret operations with a mysterious condition of 100 million yen in cash and chocolates.
title: Dr. Chocolate

overview: In this provocative true-crime docuseries, a woman dedicates her life to finding out the truth behind her brother's death.
title: Il principe

overview: The incredible stories of how some of Scottish football's biggest stars made their names on the pitch... and off it.
title: Icons of Football

overview: Ed Bassmaster is breaking out from YouTube to join CMT in his first-ever TV show where he'll unleash an astonishing range of characters on unsuspecting members of the general public on his show The Ed Bassmaster Show. With over 1.9 million YouTube subscribers and 472 million views, Bassmaster is fast becoming a household name known for his pranks and skits.
title: The Ed Bassmaster Show

overview: 'Ya Çok Seversen' is the story of the crossing of the paths of Ateş, who does not return to his family home from the boarding school he was sent to at a young age after his mother's death, and lives abroad on his own feet, does not trust anyone, and Leyla, who never knew her real family and earned money by deceiving people.
title: Ya Çok Seversen

overview: Wei Lin, a rough and illiterate female general, marries the frail and sickly young master of the Gu family, Gu Mingzhu, in a desperate attempt to clear the unjust accusations against the late Crown Prince. Little does she know that the sickly young master Gu Mingzhu was actually the cunning and ruthless villain Jiang Juan in disguise. He enters Wei's residence intending to steal the precious cure, Flame Jade. However, to his surprise, Jiang Juan unknowingly falls for Wei Lin in the process.
title: My Lady General

overview: Three journalists investigate the shocking case of Thomas Gotthard, a priest who killed his wife and disposed of the body. The documentary focuses on uncovering the motive behind the crime.
title: Præsten fra helvede

overview: Starting in 1967, with practically no knowledge of the music industry, Claude Nobs began turning his sleepy hometown on the shores of Lake Geneva into a destination for international music artists. Aretha Franklin, Nina Simone, David Bowie, Miles Davis, Etta James, Prince, Talking Heads... the list goes on, and eventually they all came out to Montreux. And when they did, Claude filmed and recorded everything in meticulous detail, resulting in a UNESCO recognised archive of extraordinary depth and quality. From revelatory live performances to jaw-dropping and intimate interview footage, this documentary miniseries provides an immersive window into the unique world of Claude Nobs and his love for music.
title: They All Came Out to Montreux

overview: Look Into My Eyes explores the story of Dr. George Kenney and his fall from grace after 10 years as a beloved principal at North Port High School in Florida where he practiced hypnosis on students. In 2011, three teenage students died after a series of suspicious events
title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes

overview: A famous singer gets the chance to live in anonymity when he fills in for a wrestler. However, he is on his heels by a journalist determined to end his career... and steal his heart.
title: Máscara contra Caballero

overview: Rural forests and meadows aren't the only places wildlife thrives. Our urban centers are filled with exotic animals in some of the most unlikely locations, often hidden from the casual observer. From back alleys to swamps, our major cities sometimes include resident giant snakes, large snails, boars armed with razor-sharp tusks, endangered sea turtles and unusual birds. With the help of local experts and residents, Mireya Mayor tracks down creatures adapted to city life by trekking through urban swamps, lagoons, traffic-heavy streets, hidden passageways and shopping districts. Along the way Mireya discovers a surprisingly diverse range of animals, including giant Burmese pythons and feral hogs, in three iconic cities.
title: Wild Nights with Mireya Mayor

overview: Everyone can relate to the experience of a first date: the promise of potential love when it goes well and the hilariously awkward moments if it crashes and burns. From executive producer Ellen DeGeneres, narrated by Drew Barrymore and based on the hit U.K. format, this new series offers a voyeuristic look at a variety of real first dates happening throughout one night at the same restaurant in Chicago. The daters are of all ages, backgrounds and from across the U.S. The audience will be along for the ride in a refreshingly authentic viewing experience that plays like a real-life romantic comedy. At the end of each episode, we will find out if the participants want to see each other again for a second date or if they head back to love's drawing board in First Dates.
title: First Dates

overview: Ari Shemer was the greatest singer Israel knew in the 1970's, and a legend in his own lifetime. Decades later, Lenny Shemer, his grandson, turns out to be a musical prodigy and signs up for a famous reality-TV singing competition that may turn him into a pop sensation. So why is his father, Kobi, Ari's son, so underappreciated by his peers? How is it that the great talent seems to have skipped over him with such cruel nonchalance? This is a musical drama about the strange nature of talent, three generations of musicians and the echoes left between them.
title: Hed Kolkha

overview: Best in Chow follows comedian Matt Richards as he travels to the biggest state fairs and street scenes across the country to find America's wildest foods and most creative cooks to judge the best of the best.
title: Best in Chow

overview: The all-new series features a panel of celebrity chefs and culinary influencers including Aarti Sequeira, Gina Neely, Leah Cohen, Rocco DiSpirito and more as they sample the most delicious and extravagant spins on familiar dishes.
title: Deliciously Twisted Classics

overview: From a cliffside pod in the mountains of Peru to a Tokyo eatery filled with ninjas, the series takes viewers on a tour of some of the most unusual and unique restaurants - where food is just one part of the experience.
title: 1,000 Ways to Dine

overview: Capital's Summertime Ball is a music festival held in London in London the radio station Capital.
title: Capital's Summertime Ball

overview: A successful thirtysomething couple find themselves at a financial dead end; they are faced with an extreme lifestyle change to pay for their debts. The luxury lifestyle ends when they are forced to move into a rented apartment in the suburbs. But to their friends, they hold up a facade and explain it all with downshifting.
title: Downshiftaajat

overview: The C More original series Kotka 10 is an intimate drama about the rescuers of the Kotka central fire station, their exciting and dangerous work tasks and their mutual relationships. The rescue missions seen in the series are based on real cases.
title: Kotka 10

overview: Margot is a wealthy hotel heiress. David juggles three jobs. Their plan to recoup their exes proves that hearts heal in unexpected ways — and places.
title: Un Cuento Perfecto

overview: The Girlfriend Experience is an anthology series, which explores the complex dynamics of transactional relationships.
title: The Girlfriend Experience

overview: Ramyun Brothers go to a famous tourist spot and open a ramyeon restaurant. They prepared 21 ramyeon recipes that can show the taste of Korea to people. As they serve various kinds of ramyeons, their goal is to capture the Japanese people who are used to ramen and promote Korean-style ramyeon to them. Kang Ho-dong, Lee Seung-gi, and Bae In-hyuk who are serious about ramyeon gather as a team. They study the famous recipes and cook ramyeons with fresh and trendy ingredients. Every day, they must come up with a new recipe. What will happen at their ramyeon restaurant?
title: Ramyun Brothers in Japan

overview: On Patricia Aguilar's 18th birthday, she disappears from her home, leaving her family behind. After several anguished weeks without knowing anything, they recover hope when Patricia shows signs of life. But the joy turns into concern when they realize that their daughter is speaking and acting strangely as if she were controlled by someone else. They soon discover that Patricia has fled to Peru, seduced by the guru of a sexual sect who has been manipulating her via the internet for 2 years. From here, the family begins an investigation on both sides of the ocean and will not cease in their efforts to recover their daughter, even when Patricia herself denies them. Narrated in first person by the protagonists, this is a story of love and family overcoming with hints of a thriller.
title: 548 Días: Captada por Una Secta

overview: Benedikt Bösel was an investment banker, but then the financial crisis hit and with it the question of meaning. Today, he is a farmer, a visionary and leads a young team that is testing a radical new type of agriculture in the fight against climate change.
title: Farm Rebellion

overview: Internet celebrity Xu Luo cheated during her marriage, greatly humiliating her husband, a famous MCN president, Lu Zezhen. They met again a year later, with Lu Zezhen swearing to seek revenge and beginning to pursue Xu Luo fervently, even kneeling and confessing his love for her in a live broadcast on the Internet. In the end, the two cleared up their misunderstandings and revealed the details of the "infidelity scandal" to the netizens. As the woman who plotted that "scandal", Shen Ruoxi's reputation was completely ruined. Xu Luo and Lu Zezhen rekindled their love and began their enviable, sweet life together.
title: Love Starts After Divorce

overview: Elijah Levi, a successful comedian in 1942 Palestine, is deported by the British authorities to Carthago, a detainee camp, in which he is held with Jewish underground warriors and Nazi criminals.
title: Carthago

overview: Kate Leeming sets out to complete the first ever bicycle journey down the Skeleton Coast where the Namib Desert meets the Atlantic Ocean. On the fringe of the Namib Desert lies the Skeleton Coast. It is the Holy Grail in Exploration.
title: Diamonds in the Sand

overview: A three-show special in which the presenter, Samanta Villar 's own pregnancy, was narrated, along with other exceptional pregnancy stories. During the program, Samanta recounted that she had been trying to get pregnant for more than four years, so she had to resort to egg donation. She finally had her children Damià and Violeta at the age of 40, whose birth was reported on the program.
title: 9 meses con Samanta

overview: On a cold December day in 2017, the bodies of Multi-Billionaire power couple, Barry and Honey Sherman, are found cruelly and bizarrely posed in the basement of their Toronto mansion. The case immediately becomes headline news attracting global interest. More than five years later, no suspects have been named, no arrests have been made, and the double-murder case remains unsolved. Now, in a four-part series, the nation's leading Investigative Journalist and pre-eminent expert on the case, Kevin Donovan, is on a quest to uncover the truth. Told from his perspective, Billionaire Murders reveals an intimate look at who the Shermans were and what may have happened to them. Featuring exclusive access to prominent Canadians who knew Barry and Honey, as well as Donovan's fellow journalists and several people who are integral to the investigation, this series delves deep into the mystery of their murders including many twists, turns and outrageous conspiracy theories about "who dunnit".
title: Billionaire Murders

overview: Rob Collins and a team of First Nations investigators delve into 65,000 years of Aboriginal Australian invention, looking at how landscapes were transformed, how events were recorded, the use of navigation tools, and how societies were organised.
title: The First Inventors

overview: The story of a reckless mother and a cool daughter living together without countermeasures.
title: Not Others

overview: Sang Zhi falls in love with Duan Jia Xu, a boy who often comes to her house to play games in her older brother's room. He is seven years older than her. Sang Zhi had a crush on Duan Jia Xu when she was young, but they lost contact with each other for some reason. After she graduates, she joins the university in the city he is in, and during their day-to-day intimate and close interaction, they slowly fall in love.
title: Hidden Love

overview: Sisterhood is a Chinese female overseas inspirational struggle epic drama directed by Guo Shimin ("Soul Ferry") and starring Xiao Yan ("Republican Detective", "Half Sweet and Half Hurt") and Dai Xiangyu ("Three Lives Three Worlds Pillow Book", "The Spoiled Consort"). Xiao Yan and Dai Xiangyu join hands to renew the previous relationship of "The Little Nyonya" and tell the story of thousands of emotions down in the South China Sea; an inspirational saga of the era, a new female-focused work; the wonderful brush depicts the spirit of Chinese overseas struggle, and the beauty of Chinese culture in the vicissitudes of the sea.
title: Sisterhood

overview: Guan Wen, Jing Zhiqiu, and Chen Xuanxuan are three women with very different personalities who encounter problems and conflicts at their respective ages of 30. The mirror image reflects the painful point of the existence of women and their strong power to against the current in the face of crisis.
title: Stand or Fall

overview: This documentary series allows you to live, in total immersion, the daily life of a group of forestry workers in Mistassini.
title: Vie de chantier

overview: Phil, Vincent, Mel, Carl and Vanessa, now in their thirties, reunite following the death of their old friend Mathieu, who was part of their once tight-knit gang back in high school. During the funeral wake organized at the deceased's parents' house, the old friends remember with nostalgia the epic party that took place there in 2005. With hindsight, they realize that this evening with the scent of peach schnapps marked their lives in many ways.
title: 20h30 chez Mathieu

overview: The testers are back! A decade later, Étienne and Patrice take up the same mission: to answer the most original questions by putting themselves to the test! More assumed and drooling, the duo which has not gained anything in maturity is unleashed in physical, scientific and absurd tests.
title: Les testeurs

overview: Loved by the public, Chuck seems like a real good guy. When he finds himself on the front page of every newspaper and gossip magazine after a scandal that involves him, all of Quebec is shocked, but for those closest to him, this incident is the last straw. His reputation is destroyed and he goes on a retreat to a recovery home for people suffering from different kinds of addictions in order to persuade his wife, his agent and his audience of his (relative) good will. Here's the rub: Chuck doesn't really think he needs help... He tells anyone who will listen that he's just a party guy.
title: Bon matin Chuck (ou l'art de réduire les méfaits)

overview: The show observes celebrities running a pop-up restaurant in a remote rural town. Consulted by the best chefs in the country, the restaurant serves fantastic french cuisine using local ingredients. You can also enjoy watching what celebs are doing for running a restaurant, from cooking, serving the customers, and managing everything.
title: Bistro Shigor

overview: The drama series Greenleaf takes viewers into the unscrupulous world of the Greenleaf family and their sprawling Memphis megachurch, where scandalous secrets and lies are as numerous as the faithful. Born of the church, the Greenleaf family love and care for each other, but beneath the surface lies a den of iniquity - greed, adultery, sibling rivalry and conflicting values - that threatens to tear apart the very core of their faith that holds them together.
title: Greenleaf

overview: In the midst of heartbreak over being dumped by her designer boyfriend and losing her former job, Aoi Sumire is encouraged after she lands a job interview for her dream lingerie brand "An Lis". While on the way to the interview, she encounters a mysterious younger man named Takenouchi Souichi, and begins to find herself drawn to him…
title: I Can't Believe I'm Keeping a Pimp

overview: Xdinary Heroes's first variety show.
title: XH's Rock the World

overview: Sweden's most deprived areas are surrounded by walls and subject to special laws that claim to protect the rest of society. When the Home Secretary delivers a speech inside the largest area, known as Paradis City, she is kidnapped by masked men. Security Service agent Fredrika turns to Emir, a former MMA fighter facing a life sentence in prison, with an ultimatum - go undercover in Paradis City and find the Home Secretary if Emir wants to see his daughter again.
title: Paradis City

overview: Eight of Norway's biggest celebrities will disappear from the radar while professional investigators do everything they can to find them - and catch them.
title: Jaget

overview: 12 celebrity students check into the Cooking School to improve in the kitchen. They will undergo an intensive learning program, and in the end one student will be left with the title of "Kokkeskolens stjerneelev."
title: Kokkeskolen med Truls og Hellstrøm

overview: Ramen is a savory combination of umami-packed broth and perfectly cooked noodles. This program offers an encyclopedic view of this delectable dish, taking you on a journey across Japan to discover ever-evolving local variations. Join us as we explore a tapestry of local customs and food culture through the lens of ramen.
title: Ramen Japan

overview: Victor, Chris and Rob have always dreamed of becoming the ultimate bounty hunters. Now they challenge celebrities to escape with their gold suitcases of money. Can they catch all the celebrities?
title: Dusørjegerne – jakten på gullkofferten

overview: The first war drama series the Ukrainian TV channel 2+2 which was filmed during a full-scale war in Ukraine. The lead characters are the emergency paramedics, who were rescuing people of their city under continuous shelling and bombing.
title: I am Hope

overview: Star-studded comedy series where the aging TV stars Truls Svendsen, Harald Rønneberg and Thomas Numme work as managers for other celebrities.
title: Kjendis AS

overview: Together with well-known popular artists for the whole family, it's time for a big folk festival in Scandinavia's largest water park. There will be surprises, sing-alongs and lots of fun!
title: Sommerfest fra Telemark

overview: Award-winning actor and producer Anthony LaPaglia unravels an epic story of Italian organised crime gang - the Black Hand - which terrorised Italian Australians working around the cane fields of North Queensland in the 1930s.
title: The Black Hand

overview: Biologist Patrick Aryee sets out on a breath-taking global road trip, answering some big questions about the vast natural world. From the jungles of Costa Rica to the rainforests of British Columbia, from the treetops to the unseen world beneath the ground, he reveals the complex web of interactions that connect the smallest of creatures to the mightiest carnivores on the planet.
title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World

overview: The artist Kjartan Lauritzen - Sognefjord-guy with a damn big grin, buys a hotel with his wife and brother at home in Sandefjord. And goes on tour. Simultaneously.
title: 6899 til eg dør

overview: When Henry is matched with Melissa - a fellow homebound 30-something - they conspire to fake a relationship to get their parents off their backs.
title: Homebound 3.0

overview: Ivan Kolesnikov leads a quiet life in the town of Kirovsk, where he owns a small cafe. When bandits suddenly appear in his establishment, Ivan, protecting his wife, becomes an unwitting killer of the raiders. The trouble does not come alone: soon serious people come to him under the leadership of Andreas, the son-in-law and right hand of the crime boss of Primorsk - Kostas. Andreas knows the secret of Kolesnikov, who has been impersonating another person for many years...
title: Феникс

overview: The Su family has twin daughters with very different personalities. One became a doctor of geology and the other became a star in the entertainment industry, until the day she disappears leaving a letter of resignation and a lot of damage in her wake. In desperation her twin sister is kidnapped and forced to replace her on a variety tv show. On top of trying to survive the entertainment business, she also has to pretend to be her sister with her sister's rich and handsome VP boyfriend. What kind of sparks will these two start?
title: Exploration Method of Love
Tian Jiang Chu Shen Du Chong Wo

overview: Follows Paige Burcham Carlton, the owner of Joanne's Gowns in Union City, Tennessee, and her staff as they turn every customer into a princess.
title: Glamour Belles

overview: Renowned wedding and event planner Diann Valentine plans a second wedding ceremony for couples who had a disastrous walk down the aisle the first time around.
title: I Do Over

overview: The Israeli foreign intelligence agency was founded to guarantee the ongoing existence of Israel. This series takes us behind-the-scenes.
title: The History of Mossad

overview: The big set show is back. Eufòria is TV3's new music competition in which 15 contestants will compete to become the best new singer in Catalonia.
title: Eufòria

overview: Five short fiction stories that will serve as a link between the first and second seasons of 'The Protected: The Return'.
title: Historias de Protegidos

overview: Six short fiction stories that will serve, thus, as a preview and link, before the great premiere of 'UPA Next'. Beatriz Luengo, Miguel Ángel Muñoz, Mónica Cruz, Lola Herrera, Lucas Velasco and Marta Guerras star in these stories, along with several of the performers who bring the new students of the Carmen Arranz school to life, such as Almudena Salort, Nuno Gallego Karina Soro and Alex Medina.
title: Historias de UPA Next

overview: Flea Man follows, flea market veteran, Jimmy Kaplow as he exercises his shrewd eye and haggling abilities to make a profit at flea markets, yard sales, and antiques fairs.
title: Flea Man
